title: universal lid
text: universal lid. I purchased a new pots and pans set and of course the lids never fit the fry pans.  I had an 8" and a 10" than needed lids and these are what I purchased.  The silicone (or like) edge sort of sucks right down on the pan, which I like.  They are very easy to clean, I sometime wash them on the top rack of the dishwasher with no issues. I have tried others, but I like the knob handle on the lid.  I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.

product_metadata.title: Houseables Universal Pot Lid, Pan Cover, Silicone, Tempered Glass, Black, Fits 6", 7", 8", 4mm Thick, Vented, Replacement Top for Crockpot, Cast Iron Skillet, Heat Resistant Handle, Dishwasher Safe
features: INDUSTRIAL GRADE TEMPERED GLASS - Our 4mm thick tempered glass pot lid has been designed with increased strength to provide you with the most robust lid on the market. Our universal pot lid won’t crack, break, or shatter if dropped from heights lower than 7 feet. Maximum temperature for this product is 180 Celsius, 356 Fahrenheit.

UNIVERSAL USE - Our lid comes in 3 different sizes you can choose from to fit your needs. Ideal for instant pots, multi-use pots, and other ordinary pots and pans. The durable and high tempered glass can bear high temperatures, making it the perfect universal pot lid for all uses.

PROVIDES YOU WITH MORE SAFETY - The tempered glass lid provides you with a steam vent and a 304 stainless steel rim that is free of BPA. Can withstand temperatures well above this product's maximum recommended usage while being 100% dishwasher safe. Additionally, the handle is heat resistant to prevent burns.
TRANSPARENT LID FOR FASTER COOKING - We’ve designed our universal pot lid with a clear and transparent view so you can check on your cooking food without removing the lid and slowing cooking time.
PUT A LID ON IT: Sure, you could continue to cook those side dishes without a lid, but it will take you forever. Watch your water boil faster and your veggies steam better with our universal lid!
